<script>

const AuthService = (() => {
  let clientPromise = null;
  let scriptPromise = null;

  function loadAuth0Script() {
    if (window.auth0?.createAuth0Client) {
      return Promise.resolve();
    }

    if (!scriptPromise) {
      scriptPromise = new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const script = document.createElement("script");

        script.src =
          "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@auth0/auth0-spa-js@2.0.4/dist/auth0-spa-js.production.js";

        script.async = true;
        script.crossOrigin = "anonymous";

        script.onload = resolve;
        script.onerror = () => reject(new Error("Auth0 script failed to load"));

        document.head.appendChild(script);
      });
    }

    return scriptPromise;
  }

  async function getClient() {
    await loadAuth0Script();

    if (!clientPromise) {
      clientPromise = window.auth0.createAuth0Client({
        domain: "login.nola.com",
        clientId: "NaH6oNwKnnx6ygH27LTPY1PApkRdNTJU",
        authorizationParams: {
          redirect_uri:
            "https://www.nola.com/auth0-redirect",
        },
      });
    }

    return clientPromise;
  }

  async function getIdToken() {
    try {
      const client = await getClient();
   
      
      await client.getTokenSilently();

      const claims = await client.getIdTokenClaims();
  
      
      if(!claims?.__raw) {
        throw new Error('Auth0 did not return an ID token');
      }

      return claims?.__raw || null;
    } catch (error) {
      throw error;
    }
  }

  async function isLoggedIn() {
    const token = await getIdToken();
    
    return !!token;
  }
  
  async function isAuthenticated() {
    const client = await getClient();
    const isAuthenticated = await client.isAuthenticated();
    console.log("authenticatedFetch => isAuthenticated: ", isAuthenticated);
    return isAuthenticated;
  }

  return {
    getIdToken,
    isLoggedIn,
    isAuthenticated,
  };
})();

async function authenticatedFetch(url, options = {}) {
  let token; 
  let auth0Id;
  
  const SEND_ERROR_LOGS = false;
  
  try {
    token = await AuthService.getIdToken();
  } catch (error){
    console.error("Authentication using getIdToken() failed:", error);
    auth0Id = Connext?.Storage?.GetUserData()?.MasterId;
    if(SEND_ERROR_LOGS){
        // Send error to logging endpoint
        try {
          await fetch('https://aos.theadvocate.com/api/v1/logs/auth-error',{
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
              "Content-Type": "application/json",
            },
            body: JSON.stringify({
              message: error?.message || 'No error message',
              name: error?.name,
              code: error?.error,
              requestUrl: url,
              account: Connext?.Storage?.GetUserData()?.Email,
            })
          })
        } catch(loggingError){
          console.error("Failed to send auth error to server:", loggingError);
        }
    }
  }

  return fetch(url, {
    ...options,
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(options.headers || {}),
      Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`,
      "X-Master-ID": auth0Id || null
    },
  });
}     

async function authenticatedFetchData(url, options = {}) {
  const response = await authenticatedFetch(url, options);
  const data = await response.json();

  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(
      data?.error ||
        data?.message ||
        data ||
        `Request failed with status ${response.status}`
    );
  }
  
  

  return data;
}

function getDaysBetween(dateStr1, dateStr2) {
  // Append T00:00:00Z to force strict UTC parsing
  const d1 = new Date(`${dateStr1.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);
  const d2 = new Date(`${dateStr2.slice(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`);

  // Calculate the difference in milliseconds
  const diffInMs = d2 - d1;

  // Convert milliseconds to days (1 day = 24h * 60m * 60s * 1000ms)
  const msInDay = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

  return Math.round(diffInMs / msInDay);
}

        function emailAutofill(navigaEvent) {
            const email = navigaEvent.detail?.EventData?.AuthProfile?.email
                       || navigaEvent.detail?.EventData?.MG2AccountData?.Email;
            if (!email) return;
        
            const interval = setInterval(function() {
                document.querySelectorAll('input[type="email"]').forEach(function(input) {
                    if (!input.value) input.value = email;
                });
            }, 300); 
        
            setTimeout(function() { clearInterval(interval); }, 10000);
        }
        
        document.addEventListener("onHasAccess", emailAutofill, { once: true });
        document.addEventListener("onAuthorized", emailAutofill, { once: true });
        document.addEventListener("onHasNoActiveSubscription", emailAutofill, { once: true });
        document.addEventListener("onFinish", emailAutofill, { once: true });

(function () {
  // console.log("jw event tracking v2");

  // ─── GA4 helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // GA4 event names must be snake_case, ≤40 chars, no dots or capitals.
  // e.g. 'firstFrame' → 'first_frame', 'adImpression' → 'ad_impression'
  function toSnakeCase(str) {
    return str.replace(/([A-Z])/g, "_$1").toLowerCase();
  }

  // ─── Shared listener attachment ────────────────────────────────────────────
  function attachListeners(player, elementId) {
    [
      "play",
      //"pause",
      "complete",
      "firstFrame",
      //"adImpression",
      //"adComplete",
      "error",
    ].forEach((evt) => {
      player.on(evt, (data) => {
        const item = player.getPlaylistItem() || {};
        //console.log("evt", data, item);

        const eventPayload = {
          jw_event: evt,
          media_id: item.mediaid ?? null,
          media_title: item.title ?? null,
          element_id: elementId ?? null,
          media_tags: item.tags ?? null,
          media_playlist: item.feedid ?? null,
          //media_duration: player.getDuration?.() ?? null,
          //media_position: player.getPosition?.() ?? null,
          page_location: window.location.href,
          page_title: document.title,
        };

        window.dataLayer = window.dataLayer || [];

        window.dataLayer.push({
          event: "jw_player_" + toSnakeCase(evt),
          ...eventPayload,
        });

        // console.log("jw evt", evt, eventPayload);
      });
    });
  }

  // ─── Core patching logic ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function patchJWPlayer() {
    const origJW = window.jwplayer;

    // Retroactively instrument players that are already set up.
    // JW stamps the '.jwplayer' class on the container when setup() completes —
    // far more reliable than integer-index enumeration.
    document.querySelectorAll(".jwplayer[id]").forEach((el) => {
      const player = origJW(el.id);
      if (player && !player.__myHooked) {
        attachListeners(player, el.id);
        player.__myHooked = true;
      }
    });

    // Patch window.jwplayer to instrument all future players.
    window.jwplayer = function () {
      const instance = origJW.apply(this, arguments);
      const elementId =
        typeof arguments[0] === "string" ? arguments[0] : arguments[0]?.id;

      if (!instance.__myHooked) {
        const origSetup = instance.setup.bind(instance);
        instance.setup = function (config) {
          const player = origSetup(config);
          attachListeners(player, elementId);
          return player;
        };
        instance.__myHooked = true;
      }
      return instance;
    };

    // Preserve all static properties and prototype so nothing downstream breaks.
    Object.keys(origJW).forEach((k) => {
      window.jwplayer[k] = origJW[k];
    });
    window.jwplayer.prototype = origJW.prototype;
  }

  // ─── Entry point ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  // Poll until window.jwplayer is available (handles async script loading),
  // then patch immediately. If it's already present, the interval fires once
  // on the next tick and clears itself.
  const waitForJW = setInterval(() => {
    if (!window.jwplayer) return;
    clearInterval(waitForJW);
    patchJWPlayer();
  }, 50);
})();

    window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;

  buttonURL.searchParams.set("returnUrl", cleanPageUrl);

  const trackingKeys = [
    "utm_source",
    "utm_medium",
    "utm_campaign",
    "g2i_source",
    "g2i_campaign",
    "checkout_trigger",
  ];

  trackingKeys.forEach(function (key) {
    const value = searchParams.get(key);

    if (value) {
      buttonURL.searchParams.set(key, value);
    }
  });
  
  // Add GA4 Article title tracking param
  if (document.title && document.title.includes(" | ")) {
    ga4Article = document.title.split(" | ")[0].replaceAll(" ", "-");

  // Add GA4 Author tracking param
  let authorMeta = document.querySelector("meta[name='author']")?.content;
  
  if (authorMeta) {

    if (authorText.includes("BY ")) {
      ga4Author = authorText
        .split("BY ")[1]
        .replace(/ \| /g, " ")
        .replace(/ /g, "-");
    } else if (authorText.length > 0) {
      ga4Author = authorText
        .trim()
        .replace(/ \| /g, " ")
        .replace(/ /g, "-");
    }
    
    buttonURL.searchParams.set("ga4.author", ga4Author);
  }
  
  // Set button URL
  linkSubscribeButton.href = buttonURL.href;
}
